title: Kraken Pro fee tiers now reward what you hold, not just what you trade
content:
TL;DR




Starting today, July 9, 2026, Kraken Pro fee tiers are based on the best of three measures: your spot trading volume, your futures trading volume, or your assets on platform (AOP).



Whichever measure qualifies you for the highest tier is the one that applies, and that tier sets your rate on both spot and futures.



AOP is assessed in real time, so eligible holdings can qualify you for a better tier even without recent trading activity.

title: Never Bet Against America
content:
Close to 40 years ago, I moved from Canada to the U.S. after acquiring a controlling interest in U.S. Global Investors. I’ve built my entire life and career here, and in all that time, I’ve never stopped marveling at my adopted country.

There’s something here you just can’t find anywhere else: the idea that an ordinary person can show up with a little energy and a lot of conviction and build something great.

That idea has a name, and this month, we’re celebrating its 250th anniversary.
